name: Containment Brood growth kit
author: Containment contributors
coordinateSystem: glTF Y-up, metres; bottom-centred origins, fronts face +Z (camera side); wall-backed pieces put the wall at -Z
format: P11 set-piece contract: COLOR_0 albedo x baked AO multiplier, one shared tangent normal atlas, single opaque finish + two emissive finishes

finishes.brood-growth: opaque organic surface (vertex colour + normal atlas)
finishes.brood-pod-glow: pulse slowly/dim: pods and brood-opening depths

models.name: brood-hive-heart
models.anchor: floor, bottom-centred, free-standing (readable from all sides)
models.placement: Swarm Junction landmark: room centre-back, outside the main fight lane; pulse brood-lantern

models.name: brood-nest-large
models.anchor: wall-backed: back plane at +Z=-depth/2 in glTF (Blender +Y)
models.placement: against a wall or into a corner, front toward the room; 1 per room max, off the fight floor

models.name: brood-creep-a
models.anchor: floor decal: underside at y=0, 2–8 cm relief, walkable
models.placement: overlap panel seams and the feet of equipment/walls; rotate/mirror freely

models.name: brood-creep-b
models.anchor: floor decal: underside at y=0, 2–8 cm relief, walkable
models.placement: overlap panel seams and the feet of equipment/walls; rotate/mirror freely

models.name: brood-creep-c
models.anchor: floor decal: underside at y=0, 2–8 cm relief, walkable
models.placement: overlap panel seams and the feet of equipment/walls; rotate/mirror freely

models.name: brood-creep-wall
models.anchor: wall crust: local underside is the wall plane; rotate -90° about X so it stands on a wall facing the room
models.placement: climb walls/equipment sides from floor creep up to ~2 m

models.name: brood-web-short
models.anchor: anchor A at origin, anchor B at +X=span (glTF +X); scale X to match the real gap
models.placement: floor-to-wall, wall-to-wall or across a doorway top; rotate about the A→B axis to tilt the membrane

models.name: brood-web-medium
models.anchor: anchor A at origin, anchor B at +X=span (glTF +X); scale X to match the real gap
models.placement: floor-to-wall, wall-to-wall or across a doorway top; rotate about the A→B axis to tilt the membrane

models.name: brood-web-long
models.anchor: anchor A at origin, anchor B at +X=span (glTF +X); scale X to match the real gap
models.placement: floor-to-wall, wall-to-wall or across a doorway top; rotate about the A→B axis to tilt the membrane

models.name: brood-pods-small
models.placement: in clutches at nest feet, corners and duct mouths; never in the open fight lane

models.name: brood-pods-large
models.placement: in clutches at nest feet, corners and duct mouths; never in the open fight lane

models.name: brood-pods-hatched
models.placement: in clutches at nest feet, corners and duct mouths; never in the open fight lane

models.name: brood-burst-duct
models.anchor: floor, bottom-centred over a 1.6 m deck panel or vent
models.placement: the swarm's entry: at a room edge or vent; combine with creep fanning away

models.name: brood-consumed-shell
models.anchor: bottom-centred; inner cavity fits a 1.2 x 0.8 x 1.0 m box (scale to the prop's bounds)
models.placement: over an existing console/crate: place at the prop origin, non-uniform scale to its bounds
